_comment: OPTIONAL — mapping file only; it has never been run and the app never queries this field. Do not use unless an ELSER inference endpoint is actually running. Adds a semantic_text field populated through the .elser-2-elasticsearch inference endpoint (Elastic's own trained sparse model). That endpoint needs an ML node (Elastic recommends 8 GB with ELSER) and, on some distributions, a trial/subscription — see README.md in this folder and docs/SPONSORS.md for which mode Solvia actually ran (built-in search is the shipped default; ELSER is NOT claimed). The shipped Elastic path is the keyword multi_match in colleges.mapping.json.
